_readme: Hand-kept list (issue #16, milestone 5; epic #7, decision D6). For registry rows with no data link (no portal, or pages, viewers and downloads only), what the place does offer. The harvest turns each resource into an index entry of type 'hand-kept <kind>', so search can point to it. Nothing here is fetched.
Edit by hand and review in a pull request. An entry is used only while its source_id and entity both match a registry row (a test checks this), and only while no adapter reads that row.
kind: page | viewer | search | download-page | dashboard | pdf | request-form. source: where the link comes from. recorded: when it was added. checked: true only after a person has opened the link.
Seeded 2026-11-14 from the State's parcel page (https://gis.ny.gov/parcels) for counties whose own registry row has no data link. Those links are the State's, not yet checked by us.
